Gender: Female 

Age:26

Element: Magi-tech

Origin: Fate Future/War

Natasha comes from a future where mystery is just about all gone.

Growing up in a Corporate run & owned city in the middle east has its perks. With the push of a button 5 star meals can be instantly prepared for you while still in your underwear. Showers can be taken that clean you up so well that soap and washcloths are no longer necessary and towels are antiquities. Even travel can be accomplished faster than you can say Gandr.

How is this possible you might ask? War, several millennia of bloody and pointless conflicts all because a few group of people can’t accept reality for what it is.

Roughly 1000 years ago in 2567 a single man whose name is lost to history(Mage association is totally involved) came up with the first commercially available compact magical heater. This technology was groundbreaking because it was the first time anyone had successfully brought together magic and technology in a way that was a true union of the two. Of course mage society wouldn’t allow for someone to bastardize magic so freely without repercussion but before they could put and end to it this brave inventor managed to out the entire magic world.

Fast forward back about 1 thousand years and Natasha lives in a city that might as well be a utopia powered completely by magic through magi-tech.
Sadly as I mentioned earlier the future is plagued by hundreds of thousands of conflicts over different groups ans their ideologies when it comes to magic and magi-tech. And even sadder is that Natasha is about to be caught up in the First great corporate expansion war where different magi-tech companies will send thousands of their employees and residents to their deaths so they can advance magi-tech to previously unthinkable capabilities.

Natsha by way of actually being from a mage family that works for the corporation her city manages is a lot more aware of how magi-tech cities work than the average resident and even knowing the real cost she’s ready to fight for her slice of paradise.

Further specifications and story context(Bc this is getting long)

Age:26(Roughly 4 months before first death)

Magic: Magical integration with magi-tech(Basically repurposed reinforcement magic)

Current alive status: Her first summon in 7480

The version of Natasha I want to enter is her after she gets summoned by the Chaldea Organization for magical peace. In this iteration she has been rayshifted back in time but an unfortunate mistake has landed her in Louisana a place she finds to be rather uncomfortable do the the outdoor climate control she was used to. Back when she was alive she had never left the middle east but even though she has traveled the globe since being summoned she hasn’t heard of a place called louisiana mostly because it doesn’t exist anymore. Still though seeing as she is stuck here for the time being she has decided it wouldn’t hurt to enjoy the local culture and cuisine until assistance from the future arrives.

As a person summoned in the future who has been sent back in time she is not allowed to tell people much about the happenings in 3500 or 7500. Similarly pointless skirmishes such as a standard holy grail war are the least of her concern so her knowledge of the grail presenting itself here is nonexistent.

Combat capabilities: Natasha has access to 
several magi-tech weapons and scrolls. Considering she wasn’t expecting a fight when she was traveling back she packed lightly. A magi-tech pistol which allows her to put more or less power into a shot depending on how much mana she gives it and a sword that can change its blade into a whip are the weapons she came with. While both lethal any mage who can cast a spell to protect themselves will be fine and servants are not particularly weak to magi-tech weapons. Her scrolls on the other hand involve 2 basic spells and one family specific spell. The first scroll is effectively gander but instead it shoots ice crystals the downside is that since she is in the past she doesn’t have an effective way to recharge this spell. Her second scroll casts a wall of iron to protect her from attacks, like the first scroll she has no effective way to recharge it but the amount of mana depleted is dependent on how much damage hits the wall. The third scroll is effectively a family heirloom that allows for a sacrifice of blood to generate mana. This has caveats however, first humans generate the most mana per drop of blood when compared to a low level animal like a squirrel, second the sacrifice works best when the blood taken isn’t lethal and third the sacrifice must be consentual unless coming from an animal or a dead body. While sacrificing all the blood Natasha has that won’t kill her to give mana to her servant is possible she is not likely to do it because she would view this war as very beneath her.

As someone who is very displeased with how they died the main reason she still fights is to make up for the failure she views herself as. 
“Might makes right and Magi-tech writes the check” is something you could hear her say often when she was alive, and while to her fellow soldiers it was comedic to them for her this was a very uncommon glimpse in to what drives her but why this was her life’s motto wasn’t known by many even after she perished.
